Nineteen comments

Delaney’s

This comes from the brothers Mike & Paddy Rafferty [ flute & lilting respectively ] from the “Leg Of The Duck” cassette tape recording which I’ve just posted. Lovely in its’ simplicity.
This is in Breathnach’s Vol.1 as“Port Tineatha”, but in Dmix, instead of Emix - the lad have transposed it up a whole tone.

↳ Posted by Kenny on February 12th, 2006.

Reminds me of the Walls of Liscarrol, which is played in both Edor and Dmix.

↳ Posted by slainte on February 12th, 2006.

Little Black Pig

I heard this song on a youtube video, played by Micho Russell. ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y9eC_MYp-5I ) The first song he plays is The Southwest Wind or Connie the Soldier on thesession.org. Russell’s playing helped to inspire to me starting learning the tin whistle, after playing Irish mandolin for 4 years. I was surprised that it was not on here, so I figured I would add it.

The Little Black Pea

Scored from a recording on RTE of Micho Russell playing the tune. I have not been able to locate the tune anywhere, either in recorded or scored form. Micho played it in an AB structure, but I find it sounds just as good in the traditional AABB format.
